boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Cal Poly Pomona study environments, from quiet library floors and reservable collaboration rooms to computer-equipped and transfer-student spaces.

cards.title: Settle In With a Desktop and Study Table
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, first-floor exterior entrance
cards.notes: Enter from outside Building 15, then choose a computer or study table; bathrooms and on-floor printing support longer work sessions.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock computer lab with desktops, tables, printing, and its own exterior entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map identifies the first-floor lab as a 24/7 facility and says it has computers, bathrooms, study tables, and printing.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 according to the current official campus-map listing; use the exterior first-floor entrance.

cards.entity_name: University Library First-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Work on a Designated Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, first floor
cards.notes: Bring silent work and keep calls away from the study area; library policy designates this entire floor for quiet use.
cards.short_summary: A policy-designated quiet floor for reading and concentration inside the University Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library’s current conduct policy designates the first floor as one of its Quiet Floors.
cards.access_notes: The University Library is open to all visitors; enter only during posted library hours and follow Quiet Floor rules.

cards.title: Draft and Print in One Work Zone
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, second floor
cards.notes: Use a research workstation for document work, then release color or black-and-white printing from this floor’s stations.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor workstation area with both color and black-and-white printing support.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s current printing page identifies the second-floor Productivity Center and lists one color and one black-and-white printer there.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted University Library hours; printing requires BroncoBucks or funds added to a Pharos account.

cards.title: Pair Coursework With Nearby Academic Help
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, second floor
cards.notes: Set up near the Learning Resource Center when tutoring may help, and use the Learning Commons black-and-white print station as needed.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor commons near tutoring services, research help, and a black-and-white printer.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP identifies the Learning Resource Center on the library’s second floor, while the library lists a black-and-white printer in the second-floor Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted University Library hours; tutoring and workshops follow Learning Resource Center availability.

cards.title: Move Upstairs for Computer-Based Work
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, fourth floor
cards.notes: Choose a fourth-floor research workstation when your assignment needs a library computer, with black-and-white printing available nearby.
cards.short_summary: An upper-floor computer area with research workstations and same-floor printing.
cards.evidence_claim: The library states that all research workstations can print and lists a black-and-white printer in the fourth-floor computer area.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted University Library hours; submitted print jobs must be released from a station on the same floor.

cards.entity_name: University Library Fifth-Floor Quiet Computer Area
cards.title: Combine Quiet-Floor Rules With Desktop Access
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, fifth floor
cards.notes: Take computer-heavy solo work here, keep conversation and device audio down, and release printing before leaving the floor.
cards.short_summary: A computer-equipped area on one of the library’s three designated Quiet Floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy designates the fifth floor as quiet, and the current printing page lists a black-and-white printer in its computer area.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; keep phones on vibrate and take necessary calls only to the locations permitted by library policy.

cards.entity_name: University Library Sixth-Floor Quiet Computer Area
cards.title: Take Focused Work to the Top Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15, sixth floor
cards.notes: Bring concentration-intensive computer work upstairs, observe the quiet designation, and use the floor’s black-and-white printer if needed.
cards.short_summary: The library’s highest listed quiet study floor, with a computer area and printing station.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy designates the sixth floor as quiet, and the current printing page lists a black-and-white printer in its computer area.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted University Library hours and observe the library’s Quiet Floor and cell-phone rules.

cards.title: Reserve a Room for Collaborative Work
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15
cards.notes: Book up to one week ahead, arrive with at least two people, and keep the session within the room policy’s three-hour maximum.
cards.short_summary: Reservable library rooms intended specifically for current CPP students working in groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The current room policy limits reservations to current CPP students, requires groups of two or more, and caps bookings at three hours.
cards.source_title: Group Study Room Reservation and Use Policy
cards.access_notes: Current CPP students need Bronco credentials; reserve no more than one room per day, up to one week ahead, within library hours.

cards.title: Plug In at a First-Come Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bronco Student Center, Building 35
cards.notes: Choose an open-air lounge, claim available furniture and charging on arrival, and bring a meal or snack if it helps the session.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, open-air study lounges with charging stations and first-come seating.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI says the BSC has dozens of quiet, open-air study spaces plus lounge furniture and charging stations available first come, first served.
cards.access_notes: Current summer 2026 hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; the BSC is closed August 10–14 for staff training and on weekends through August 16.

cards.title: Spread Out With Transfer-Focused Resources
cards.subtitle: Student Services Building, Building 121, first floor
cards.notes: Transfer students can use the tables, computer and whiteboard; enter through the sliding doors and look immediately left of the ID counter.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated transfer-student lounge with tables, chairs, a computer, whiteboard, television, and basic kitchen equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP places the lounge on Building 121’s first floor and lists study tables, chairs, a computer, whiteboard, HDMI-equipped television, refrigerator, and microwave.
cards.source_title: PolyTransfer Study Lounge - A Space for Transfers
cards.access_notes: Available to transfer students during normal business hours; follow the official first-floor directions from the Student Services Building entrance.
